steps.text: The allocation key generation page displays the configuration form. Select the algorithm, fill in the parameters, and upload your data file to launch a new generation.
steps.title: Key generation page

steps.text: Click the "Algorithm" dropdown and select "OLAGSA". The parameter form specific to this genetic algorithm then appears.
steps.title: Select the OLAGSA algorithm

steps.text: Give this generation a name so you can find it in the history.
steps.title: Name the generation

steps.text: Enter the name of the column in your data file that holds the energy produced.
steps.title: Injection name

steps.text: Enter "3" in the "Iterations" field. This parameter defines the number of independent solutions computed by the OLAGSA genetic algorithm.
steps.title: Set the number of iterations

steps.text: Click "Advanced parameters" to reveal the genetic algorithm's hyperparameters: population size, crossover rates, mutation rate, and more.
steps.title: Open advanced parameters

steps.text: OLAGSA's advanced parameters are displayed: generations, population size, inter-species and intra-species crossover rates, mutation rate, expected species count, and maximum generations without improvement. Default values suit most use cases.
steps.title: Genetic algorithm hyperparameters

steps.text: Drag your CSV file into the import zone or click it to select the data file to use for generation.
steps.title: Import the data file

steps.text: Click "Launch generation" to submit the task to the OLAGSA engine. The generation immediately appears in the list with a "Pending" status.
steps.title: Launch the generation

steps.text: The "Test Run 1" generation appears in the list. A pulsing orange dot indicates it is pending processing; it turns green once the OLAGSA engine has finished.
steps.title: Generation submitted

steps.text: The computation takes a moment: refresh the list to see its result.
steps.title: Refresh

steps.text: The dot turns green — the generation is complete. The allocation keys have been computed and are ready to view by expanding the row.
steps.title: Generation completed

steps.text: Click the generation to show the keys it produced.
steps.title: Expand the generation

steps.text: The list of computed keys appears under the generation. Each key corresponds to one optimised OLAGSA solution. Click a key to view its detailed allocation.
steps.title: Allocation keys generated

steps.text: Click a key to show its allocation.
steps.title: Expand the key

steps.text: The allocation table is shown for this key, detailing the values computed by the algorithm. The "Save" button lets you store this key in the Keys module.
steps.title: Key detail and per-iteration allocation

steps.text: Click "Save" to store this allocation key in the Keys module, where it will be accessible from the community management section.
steps.title: Save the key to the module

steps.text: A confirmation dialog appears. Click the confirm button to permanently save this allocation key to the Keys module.
steps.title: Confirm saving the key
